image_description: A close-up, slightly low-resolution image showing a cluster of three to four small hamsters huddled together in a nest made of shredded white paper and grey stones. The background is a solid blue wall. The hamsters have golden-brown and cream-colored fur. One hamster on the left is facing forward, while others are turned away or sleeping.
